Microsoft just put Word, Excel, PowerPoint AND AI agents into one app. 🤯
This might be the biggest change to how we work since Office itself.

On Friday, Microsoft unveiled its new Copilot "super app" for business users.

Here's what's inside 👇

🏠 Home: chat + Microsoft's Cowork agent in one place
💻 Code: build your own apps and tools just by describing them
🤖 Autopilot: set up always-on AI agents that work for you
📄 Word, Excel & PowerPoint built right in, synced with your regular Office files

Why it matters:
Microsoft is merging a confusing lineup of Copilot products into one hub as OpenAI and Anthropic push hard into the enterprise.
The fight is no longer "which chatbot?" It's "where does your work actually happen?"

Practical takeaway for today:
Write down 3 repetitive tasks you do every week (reports, status emails, data cleanup).
Those are your first candidates for an always-on agent once these features roll out over the coming weeks.

Most features aren't widely available yet, so now is the time to prepare, not panic.

Which task would YOU hand to an AI agent first? 👇

Follow me for daily AI news you can actually use.
